scope: Top-level box size, extended-size and size-zero traversal from mov_probe / mov_read_default only. The mature MF / FFmpeg backends continue to parse media semantics and decode all audio/video tracks.
adaptations: Use reads from the same owned IStream/QFile; reject short physical headers and box extents instead of clamping; check unsigned remaining-byte bounds before adding; cap total top-level non-mdat/free/skip metadata bytes; propagate cancellation; require moov and mdat. No sample-table or bitstream parsing is copied or reimplemented.
